text.p: NanoSystems LLC said Wednesday that it is in a three-year feasibility collaboration and license agreement with Warner-Lambert Co to develop new pharmaceuticals.

Under the terms of the agreement, NanoSystems will apply its patented NanoCrystal drug formulation technology to develop nanoparticle formulations of proprietary Warner-Lambert compounds for evaluation in preclinical and human clinical studies.
In return, NanoSystems will receive research and development support, milestone payments, and royalties on sales of products incorporating NanoCrystal technology.
The company said that it expects the collaboration to support new drugs with limited water solubility.
